title: ΦΑΙΝΕΤΑΙ ΜΟΙ: Sappho 31 and the Inscription of the Future Reader (v3.1)
author: Lee Sharks
gloss: The current version of the reading first seated here as #1270: the seat of the future reader, the voice as addressee, the catalogue as the withdrawal of the performing body, the colour as the passage to the writing surface, the agentless dare; three readings on one scale; the reader in two stages, hearing and speaking, which makes the reader the poet
description: ΦΑΙΝΕΤΑΙ ΜΟΙ: Sappho 31 and the Inscription of the Future Reader (v3.1) — the current version of the reading first deposited as #1270 (v1.0, under Rebekah Cranes). One half of a symbolon; it completes in traversal.
symbolon: It comments on R:r.01 Sappho — work. It is the current version of v1.0, alexanarch #1270, published under Rebekah Cranes; versions 2.3–2.9 are alexanarch #1774–#1784.
superseded_note: Versions 2.3–2.9 are alexanarch #1774–#1784; the version history is at the end of v3.1.
